digest.component_or_area: LLM agent tool execution and convergence boundary
propositions: When tool_step_limit boundary is crossed after any tool call, pydantic-ai omits toolConfig from subsequent requests while toolUse blocks remain in history, violating Bedrock/Anthropic provider constraints and causing ValidationException 400

Current filtering mechanism (empty toolsets past limit) creates unrecoverable protocol violations; steering mechanism (synthetic tool results signaling no further tools) maintains protocol validity by keeping tool definitions advertised
Bounded recovery fallback in completion_recovery.py dies with the same 400 error when evidence tool step reaches limit, making the fallback path itself unreachable
Unit tests with FunctionModel do not catch the provider protocol constraint because FunctionModel accepts tools-less requests over toolUse history, while real providers reject this shape
Replacement steering wrapper must preserve existing budget limits (UsageLimits with request_limit and tool_calls_limit) as terminal bounds for non-cooperative models
Happy-path runs under the limit must execute tools normally and land output; runs exceeding the limit must receive steering results and still land final output through existing paths
